policy.legacy_behavior: retained as fallback and parity control until release gates close

gates.title: Shipping package and selector policy
gates.close_with: Retain a selected-root package/cook manifest and packaged selector behavior proof when a real Shipping caller exists; retain legacy startup/fallback evidence.

gates.title: Selected-route performance on target
gates.close_with: Comparable retained 1920x1080 runs on RTX 2060 Super or owner-approved RTX 3060 stand-in: selected average >=60 FPS, p99 <=16.67 ms, selected p99 no more than 0.5 ms above legacy.

gates.title: Save/content compatibility and package cook
gates.close_with: Retain the authoritative cook manifest from the next package, verify all selected-route roots/closures against it, and record the compatibility audit disposition.

gates.title: Missing/invalid definition recovery
gates.close_with: Retain owner-visible refusal screenshots and packaged missing/invalid-definition fail-closed proof, including no legacy bundle activation.
